test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana is for:

options.text: Provision of money for only BPL families
Printing of new currency after demonetisation
Provision of funding to non-corporate small business sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**Provision of funding to non-corporate small business sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) was launched by the Government of India on 8th April 2015 to provide loans up to 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
 
• The loans under PMMY are classified as MUDRA loans under the PMMY scheme.
 
• The MUDRA loans are given by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, and NBFCs.
 
• There are three categories under the MUDRA scheme: Shishu (loans up to ₹50,000), Kishor (loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (loans from ₹5,00,001 to ₹10 lakh).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shishu Category**

 
 
• In the Shishu category, loans up to ₹50,000 are provided to micro-enterprises.
 
• This is the first stage of the business, and hence, the loans are given to those who are just starting their business.
 
 
 
• **Kishor Category**
 
 
• The Kishor category provides loans ranging from ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh.
 
• This is for enterprises that are already established but need funds for further growth and expansion.
 
 
 
• **Tarun Category**
 
 
• The Tarun category provides loans ranging from ₹5,00,001 to ₹10 lakh.
 
• This is for businesses that need a larger amount of funding for further expansion.
 
 
 
• **Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA)**
 
 
• MUDRA is responsible for developing and refinancing all Micro-enterprises sector by supporting the finance institutions which are in the business of lending to micro/small business entities engaged in manufacturing, trading, and service activities.
 
• MUDRA provides refinance support to Banks / MFIs for lending to micro units having loan requirements up to 10 lakh.
 
• MUDRA provides developmental and financial support to the micro-enterprise sector.
